Create a photorealistic fantasy field-documentation photograph of an original adult fictional woman whose visible facial appearance and long dark wavy hair are guided by Image 1. She stands in a rain-dark archive hall operating a complete stone threshold that reveals a snowy ruin as a materially distinct far-side space while the near-side hall remains fully readable. One clay-and-stone golem crosses the threshold plane with coherent clipping and occlusion. Its single constructed body keeps the same packed clay and fitted stone across torso, limbs, and joints, with visible assembly seams. Its grounded step forms a contact shadow and pushes threshold dust outward as it carries one survey crate from the ruin into the hall. Preserve the reference-visible facial structure, hairline, dark wavy hair texture, and natural makeup balance. Use a medium-wide eye-level documentary composition with both spaces, full golem anatomy, crossing plane, and moved crate legible in one frame.
